mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 3.5% compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors seek yield in equities.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 3.5% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% signals tight labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in consumer spending (RSAFS > 750000) and accommodative monetary policy (FEDFUNDS < 3.5%) signals robust economic expansion, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through elevated corporate profit expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of periods when RSAFS > 750000 and FEDFUNDS < 3.5% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals weakening economic activity and reduced corporate capacity utilization, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate earnings contraction.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when INDPRO < 100 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of consumer spending (RSAFS > 750000) relative to historical norms supports sustained corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through immediate earnings momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in >55% of periods when RSAFS > 750000 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent inflation (CPIAUCSL annual change > 3.5%) triggers expectations of prolonged restrictive monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through elevated discount rates.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when CPIAUCSL annual change > 3.5% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent labor market strength (PAYEMS growth > 0.3% MoM) and rising industrial output (INDPRO > 102.0) signal robust economic activity and profit margin expansion, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in >55% of periods when PAYEMS growth > 0.3% MoM and INDPRO > 102.0 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST > 1500) indicate strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through elevated consumer spending and business investment.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in >55% of periods when HOUST > 1500 over any 3-year rolling window.
